matches.recap: West Brom staged a dramatic late revival to beat Wrexham 2-1 at The Racecourse on Tuesday.

Jurrien Timber, Eberechi Eze and Bukayo Saka all scored in seven scintillating second-half minutes to fire Arsenal to a comfortable 3-0 Champions League win against Lille at the Emirates Stadium.
Anthony Gordon scored his first Champions League goal for Barcelona as they came from behind to beat Galatasaray 4-1 in Istanbul to maintain a perfect 10-for-10 start to the season.
Viking scored a 90th-minute equaliser to hold Harry Kane and Bayern Munich to a thrilling 3-3 Champions League draw.
